_설명: 완성 5과 종합1 32번 — 원본 PDF를 다시 떠서 지문 전체를 확인한 뒤, 틀린 자리를 ④에서 ②로 옮겼다. ④의 order 뒤 목적격보어를 바른 to부정사로 고치고, ②의 「전치사 + 관계대명사」를 that으로 바꿔 틀리게 했다.

문항.prompt: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 [[틀린]]것은?
body: Most importantly, money needs to be scarce in
a predictable way. Precious metals have been
desirable as money across the millennia not only
because ①[[they]] have intrinsic beauty but also
because they exist in fixed quantities. Gold and
silver enter society at the rate ②[[at that]] they are
discovered and mined; additional precious metals
cannot ③[[be produced]], at least not cheaply.
Commodities like rice and tobacco can be grown,
but that still takes time and resources. A dictator
like Zimbabwe’s Robert Mugabe could not order
the government ④[[to produce]] 100 trillion tons of
rice. He was able to produce and distribute
trillions of new Zimbabwe dollars, ⑤[[which]] is why
they eventually became more valuable as toilet
문항.explanation: 전치사 바로 뒤에는 that을 쓸 수 없으므로 at which로 써야 한다.
